A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|'''clone trooper pilot''']] served in [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was involved in an [[Battle of Gwori|assault]] on the [[Gwori shipyards]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom" />
